import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.BufferedWriter;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
import java.util.Hashtable;

public class Cutting {

    public static int[] strToIntArr(String s) {
        String[] sArr = s.split(" ");
        int len = sArr.length;
        int[] retArr = new int[len];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            retArr[i] = Integer.parseInt(sArr[i]);
        }
        return retArr;
    }

    boolean checkSub(int[] aArr, int splitInd) {
        boolean correct = true;
        int nEven = 0;
        int nOdd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= splitInd; i++) {
            int el = aArr[i];
            if ((el % 2) == 0) {
                nEven++;
            } else {
                nOdd++;
            }
        }
        if (nEven != nOdd) {
            correct = false;
        }
        return correct;
    }

    int getMinAvailInd(int[] aArr, int nCoins, Hashtable<Integer, Boolean> cutUsed) {
        int len = aArr.length;
        int minInd = -1;
        int minCost = nCoins + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < len - 1; i++) {
            int cost = Math.abs(aArr[i] - aArr[i + 1]);
            if (cost < minCost) {
                if (checkSub(aArr, i)) {
                    if (!cutUsed.containsKey(i)) {
                        minCost = cost;
                        minInd = i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return minInd;
    }

    public int getMaxCuts(int n, int b, int[] aArr) {
        int nCoins = b;
        int nCuts = 0;
        Hashtable<Integer, Boolean> cutUsed = new Hashtable<Integer, Boolean>();
        while (nCoins > 0) {
            int ind = getMinAvailInd(aArr, nCoins, cutUsed);
            if (ind > -1) {
                cutUsed.put(ind, true);
                int cost = Math.abs(aArr[ind] - aArr[ind + 1]);
                nCoins -= cost;
                nCuts++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        return nCuts;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        BufferedWriter bw = new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(System.out));
        String nbLn = br.readLine();
        String aLn = br.readLine();
        int[] nbArr = strToIntArr(nbLn);
        int[] aArr = strToIntArr(aLn);
        Cutting cut = new Cutting();
        int n = nbArr[0];
        int b = nbArr[1];
        int maxC = cut.getMaxCuts(n, b, aArr);
        bw.write(Integer.toString(maxC));
        bw.newLine();
        bw.flush();
    }
}
</perturbed_code_1>
